:::{#thm-convex-hessian}
#### Second-derivative test for convexity

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have first and second partial derivatives
that are [continuous on](vector-calculus.qmd#def-continuous-on) $\reals^p$.

1. If $\matr{H}_f(\vx)$ is [positive semidefinite](linear-algebra.qmd#def-positive-semidefinite) for every $\vx$,
   then $f$ is [convex](algebra.qmd#def-convex-function).
2. If $\matr{H}_f(\vx)$ is [positive definite](linear-algebra.qmd#def-positive-definite) for every $\vx$,
   then $f$ is strictly convex (@def-strictly-convex).

:::

::: proof

Let $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$.
By @thm-taylor-mv with $\vecf{z} = \vy$ and $\vecf{h} = \vx - \vy$,
there is a $\midpt \in (0, 1)$ such that, with $\vecf{w} \eqdef \vy + \midpt (\vx - \vy)$,

$$
\ba
f(\vx)
&= f(\vy) + \tp{\paren{\deriv{\vx} f(\vy)}} (\vx - \vy) + \frac{1}{2}\,\tp{(\vx - \vy)}\,\matr{H}_f(\vecf{w})\,(\vx - \vy)
&& \text{(@thm-taylor-mv)}
\\
&\ge f(\vy) + \tp{\paren{\deriv{\vx} f(\vy)}} (\vx - \vy).
&& \text{(} \matr{H}_f(\vecf{w}) \text{ is positive semidefinite)}
\ea
$$

This inequality is @eq-supporting-hyperplane, so $f$ is convex by @thm-convex-first-order.
Under the hypothesis of part 2 and with $\vx \ne \vy$,
the quadratic-form term is positive, so the inequality is strict,
and $f$ is strictly convex by the last sentence of @thm-convex-first-order.

:::
